regions.tonight: Mostly dry for a time tonight. Rain will spread from the west later, turning heavy at times. Lowest temperatures of 4 to 8 degrees in fresh to strong and gusty southeast winds.
regions.tomorrow: Early Tuesday morning will start to see a clearance further west, while rain will persist in the east. There is a chance that rain will move back in over southeastern parts again come the afternoon and spread across the east coast. Strong southeast winds will veer west and ease light. Highest temperatures of 7 to 9 degrees.
